sample_unit: AI-generated images of chronic heart failure (number not reported)

links.outcome: Gender bias and anatomical inaccuracies in AI-generated medical illustrations of chronic heart failure
links.effect: AI failed to reliably generate female-specific medical images; critical anatomical errors observed, such as a patient depicted with three kidneys and incorrect organ positioning.
links.quote: Additionally, gender bias emerged, as the AI failed to reliably generate female-specific medical images.

unlisted_practices: Training clinicians in visual literacy and image interpretation to mitigate errors in AI-generated medical images
Specialized training in prompt crafting for generating medical illustrations

screen.reason: The study empirically tests the accuracy and biases of generative AI (ChatGPT/DALL-E) for creating medical illustrations via researcher-generated prompts, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice comparatively.
